title: AnalyticsEvent
responsibility: Stores timestamped analytics event payloads in events through a supplied persistence adapter.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.id
inputs.description: The primary key of one events row (the definition's primaryKey is id), supplied to find, update and delete to choose the row and included in the input object for create. The model never generates, checks or changes it, and passes it to the adapter unchanged.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.timestamp
inputs.description: The timestamp string stored in the timestamp field of an events row, supplied through create and update or used as a findBy filter. The model does not parse, format or validate it, so its format is whatever the caller supplies, and it is passed on unchanged.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.data
inputs.description: The payload stored in the data field of an events row, supplied through create and update; it is typed in the source as the AnalyticsEvent interface from core/analyticsTypes (required: id, timestamp, project, kind and action). The model neither inspects nor validates it and passes the same object reference through, since only the outer object is copied.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.find
outputs.description: The promise from the adapter's find for the events table and the requested id, returned without change. It resolves to the adapter's events row or null, as PersistenceAdapter.find declares.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.findBy
outputs.description: The promise from the adapter's findBy for the events table, returned without change. It resolves to the array of events rows the adapter returns, and the model does not filter, sort or reshape that array.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.create
outputs.description: The promise from the adapter's create for the events table, returned without change. It resolves to the row the adapter returns from create, typed as AnalyticsEventAttributes.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.update
outputs.description: The promise from the adapter's update for the events table and the requested id, returned without change. It resolves to the row the adapter returns or to null, as PersistenceAdapter.update declares.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.delete
outputs.description: The promise from the adapter's delete for the events table and the requested id, returned without change. It resolves to the boolean the adapter returns, which the model does not interpret.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Exceptions the adapter throws synchronously and promise rejections it returns pass through unchanged, because the model has no try/catch. In findBy, create and update, a getter on the caller's object can also throw during the object-spread copy, before the adapter is called.

errors.name: TypeError from missing receiver or adapter
errors.description: Thrown synchronously when a static method is called without AnalyticsEvent as its receiver (each method reads this.definition.table), or when the adapter argument is null, undefined, or lacks the method being called; the model checks neither the receiver nor the adapter first.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.find.adapter
inputs.description: The adapter instance whose find method receives the events table name and the id. The model owns no connection lifecycle and never opens or closes one.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.find.id
inputs.description: The events row id to look up, passed to adapter.find unchanged; the model does not generate or validate it.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.find
outputs.description: The promise from the adapter's find for the events table and the requested id, returned without change. It resolves to the adapter's events row or null, as PersistenceAdapter.find declares.

errors.name: Persistence operation failure
errors.description: Exceptions the adapter throws synchronously and promise rejections it returns pass through unchanged, because the model has no try/catch. The model copies no caller object in find, so no caller getter runs.

errors.name: TypeError from missing receiver or adapter
errors.description: Thrown synchronously when a static method is called without AnalyticsEvent as its receiver (each method reads this.definition.table), or when the adapter argument is null, undefined, or lacks the method being called; the model checks neither the receiver nor the adapter first.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.findBy.adapter
inputs.description: The adapter instance whose findBy method receives the events table name and a shallow copy of fields. The model owns no connection lifecycle and never opens or closes one.

inputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.findBy.fields
inputs.description: A partial events row (any subset of id, timestamp and data), shallow-copied with object spread and passed to adapter.findBy. The model does not check which fields are present or how the adapter matches them, and null or undefined reaches the adapter as an empty object.

outputs.name: AnalyticsEvent.findBy
outputs.description: The promise from the adapter's findBy for the events table, returned without change. It resolves to the array of events rows the adapter returns, and the model does not filter, sort or reshape that array.

errors.description: Exceptions the adapter throws synchronously and promise rejections it returns pass through unchanged, because the model has no try/catch. A getter on the caller's fields object can also throw during the object-spread copy, before the adapter is called.

inputs.description: A partial patch limited by the type to the optional timestamp and data fields, shallow-copied with object spread and passed to adapter.update. The model does not check the values or merge them into a stored row, and null or undefined reaches the adapter as an empty object.
